text: In World War Two, an American guided bomb was designed to be steered by pigeons. Psychologist B. F. Skinner trained pigeons to peck at a picture of the target on a little screen in the nose. If the target drifted off centre, the pecks steered it back. He used three pigeons. If one got it wrong, the other two outvoted it. It worked in tests. Officials still could not take it seriously, and it was cancelled. Dave was the backup pigeon.
